messages:
samira: hey all :wave: first week here — trying to get the example infra PR to pass but the Buildkite job fails when it calls GitHub Actions via repo_dispatch. getting a 403: 

```
2024-06-10T15:12:03Z ERROR trigger: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the repo and the pipeline but not sure which permission is missing. who manages the Buildkite GitHub App? @laura @miguel

laura: welcome! :tada: that 403 usually means the GitHub App token doesn't have access to the repo or it's not installed there. can you paste the dispatch snippet from the pipeline? pinging @devops-oncall too.

samira: snippet from infra/pipelines/service.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -X POST \
      -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
      -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/service/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{"ref":"main"}'
```

GITHUB_TOKEN is the env var Buildkite injects.

miguel: is that an installation token from the GitHub App or a user PAT? the app's installation token is scoped to which repos the app has; if the app isn't installed on `service` you'll see this 403.

laura: check org installs: https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/settings/installations, search for Buildkite and verify repo access. Buildkite supports "all repos" or a subset.

devops-oncall: on it. buildkite app is installed but limited to some repos. adding `service` to allowed repos now. i'll re-run once it propagates.

ci-bot: buildkite/job/4321 re-run requested by devops-oncall

samira: re-ran and repo_dispatch returned 204, GH Actions kicked off. thanks! :raised_hands:

laura: good. onboarding action: open a tiny PR to infra/permissions.md to list repos that need Buildkite app access and who to ping. also wrap this curl into scripts/dispatch.sh that clearly uses the org app token.

samira: will do. two quick follow-ups: 1) how to request membership in `ci-admins` team? 2) where are runbook docs for re-runs and artifact collection?

miguel: 1) request via #people-ops or DM them for team invite. 2) docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and /ci/artifacts. i'll add a short link in your PR review.

laura: if you hit flaky cache errors later, tag @eng-infra with job id and the `buildkite-agent artifact download` output so we can triage.

samira: perfect, thanks everyone :heart: i'll update infra docs and mention you on the PR.

miguel: welcome aboard — happy to pair if anything else blocks. :coffee:
